title: Initial Balance Break Types
summary: The green-close rate for each way a session resolved its initial balance — held inside (none), broke one side (single_up, single_down), or broke both (double). Each row's denominator is the sessions of that break type and its numerator the ones that closed above their open, while the row's N doubles as the break-type distribution across all sessions — one table, two readings. Group by anything else, or drop the grouping, to reuse the same question.
deltas: the N column doubles as the break-type frequency table — two classic reports in one result
per-type 95% CI instead of one blended number
condition the whole table on anything: gap state, weekday, event days
